Wide 16:9 eye-level street composition on a 28mm lens, framing Scarlett (Image 1) at the near curb in the instant before stepping into a crowded downtown crosswalk. Scarlett (Image 1) shifts weight onto the forward foot, one hand gripping a structured neutral tote, gaze fixed across the intersection, with open space ahead for the crossing. Commuters cluster around and partially frame the foreground while yellow taxis, delivery bikes, parked cars, and traffic waiting to roll occupy the street behind. Mirrored glass office towers rise through the background. Bright late-morning daylight creates crisp reflections and clean directional shadows with soft street-canyon fill. Fresh, editorial social-first product photography, clean true-to-life grading, muted urban neutrals with vivid coral accent.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
